verdict.rationale: Gitea's docs say that, in its code review workflow, submitters receiving review comments can 'respond or modify code online', which is the story's core: answering review feedback by editing code in the browser. Reviewers browsing code online supports the review side of the loop. Missing for 10: explicit documentation of the in-browser commit step (e.g., commit message or committing to the PR branch), in-depth editor docs, independent or hands-on corroboration.

support.subject: As a developer, I can respond to review feedback by editing and committing code directly in the browser

citations.quote: Submitters can receive review comments and respond or modify code online.
Reviewers can browse code online and provide review comments or feedback.
